name: Major Custom Cable
old_description: From aerospace to medical to industrial, our custom cable solutions deliver unmatched precision, durability, and performance—engineered to your exact specifications.
about:
Major Custom Cable operates from Jackson, Missouri, as an American manufacturer of custom cable assemblies. The company is backed by the Neutrik Group, pairing domestic production with global engineering expertise. Founded as a relationship-driven team, MCC focuses on mission-critical quality for customers that require dependable components and on-time delivery.

The company designs, manufactures, and tests custom cable solutions in-house, covering fiber optic, copper, and hybrid assemblies, wire harnesses, connectivity systems, Ethernet and fiber internet infrastructure, harsh-environment cables, power distribution, and professional audio cables. Capabilities span prototyping through production, with application-specific materials, ruggedized jacketing, EMI/RFI shielding, and pre-terminated fiber options. Every assembly is built and tested internally to meet defined specifications.

MCC serves aerospace, OEM, datacom, telecom, medical, AVL, broadcast, industrial, and defense sectors. Its cables integrate into complex equipment builds, mission-critical aerospace systems, patient monitoring and imaging devices, high-speed data networks, live-event production, and telecommunications infrastructure. The team brings decades of combined experience supporting customers in selecting and specifying the right assemblies for each application.

The company emphasizes in-house quality control, predictable American manufacturing schedules, fast quoting, and direct access to a dedicated sales and technical support team based in Missouri. This approach aims to reduce downtime, simplify installation, and deliver consistent performance where failure is not an option.
